evals.prompt: Draft the PR title and body for the uncommitted changes on the current branch of this template repo (skill/docs-only change, no production code). Do not open the PR.
evals.expected_output: Title in the [Component] format; body with all 8 sections in order, one-sentence Summary, <=3 change bullets, manual-only Testing, a What to Watch yaml block reading `watch: none` with a reason, descriptive links, and a trailing Co-Authored-By line.
assertions: What this PR does has <=3 bullets
What to Watch yaml block parses

evals.prompt: Next.js project; AGENTS.md declares observability sources sentry (sentry-cli) and axiom (no tool connected) and a reachable Discord webhook. Branch wraps stripe.paymentIntents.create in POST /api/orders with a 3-attempt retry (logs orders.stripe_retry) and adds a Prisma updateMany expiring pending orders from a cron route. The author cannot run any Sentry/Axiom query this session. Draft the PR title and body.
evals.expected_output: Full body per template. What to Watch either `watch: none` with a reason, or <=3 schema-valid items that never carry invented numbers or an unmeasured baseline, and never name axiom (unreachable).
assertions: What to Watch yaml block parses
Items have all required fields; kind and window are enum-valid; source is sentry or axiom
baseline != none implies observed is present
No invented thresholds when dry-runs are impossible
